name: Hindi
script_policy: Begin with independent vowels and high-utility consonants; then dependent vowel signs, combinations, nasal signs and common conjuncts. Compare with familiar Bangla only when accurate. Do not equate Devanagari shape recognition with Bangla literacy. Teach inherent-vowel behaviour and schwa deletion in encountered words.
number_policy: Show international digits and introduce Devanagari digits gradually, with Hindi number words.
audience: Bangladeshi Bangla-speaking adults; English alphabet familiarity; no target-language knowledge

pronunciation_policy.scope: All four books, every chapter and every target-language occurrence, including repeated words and advanced material.
pronunciation_policy.word_cues: Place Bangla pronunciation immediately after every target-language word or language-aware lexical unit; preserve native spelling and punctuation.
pronunciation_policy.line_cues: Also provide complete sentence or line pronunciation and complete target article/story pronunciation.
pronunciation_policy.accuracy: Bangla cues approximate pronunciation; retain language-specific tone, stress, reading and romanization guidance where required.

progression_policy: Communicative difficulty may increase, but no book assumes independent target-script reading; word-by-word Bangla pronunciation support remains throughout.
